instruction.text: Nadia eats 45% of her pizza, and Libby eats 2/5 of hers. Convert the fraction Libby has eaten into a percentage to work out who has eaten more pizza.
Cora is counting the number of red cars she sees on the motorway. 0.26 of the cars she sees are red. Convert her findings to a fraction.

atoms.a: Simplify the fraction further so that the denominator is 50.

instruction.text: Alex read 0.61 of his book on Saturday and 13% on Sunday. Convert the decimal to a percentage to work out the total percentage of the book that Alex has read over the weekend.

atoms.a: First, convert the decimal to a percentage.
Next, add up the amount Alex read each day.

instruction.text: Martin has run 3/5 of the racetrack and Florence has run 77% of the racetrack. Convert the fraction Martin has run into a percentage to work out who has run further.
John’s Electronics is having a sale on laptops. Select the best deal.
